commercialPurpose: Add concise social proof after CTA pressure with two named human quotes instead of a dense testimonial wall.
purposeLayer: Testimonials soften the conversion ask with credible human reassurance.
anatomyLayer: Two circular profile images, names, roles/company labels, short quote text, and centered spacing.
hierarchyLayer: Faces first, names second, quote snippets third.
gridRhythmLayer: Two-column quote pair on a calm white section with generous horizontal separation.
densityLimitLayer: Use 2 visible testimonials, each with one image, one name/role line, and one short quote.
originalityLayer: Learn minimal two-proof rhythm; transform photo style, quote length, card treatment, and alignment.
usageRuleLayer: Use after CTA or benefit sections when proof should reassure without derailing the conversion path.

negativeSpaceShape: wide white gap between two proof islands

breakoutBehavior: contained proof pair, no carousel required
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact names, portraits, Google role labels, quote text, or spacing.
